npc: a lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
question: God save you. What news of the parish?

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: God save you, friend! I heard Sean Ruadh Kelly talkin' of secret meetin's at the lime kiln — the whole parish is curious what he's at. What brings ye to the forge this fine spring mornin'?

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: *A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face wipes his hands on his apron and steps forward.*

npc: a lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
question: How does the harvest look this year?

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: The harvest? 'Tis early days yet—the spuds and oats are only fresh in the ground. If this soft weather holds, we'll see a fine yield come autumn.

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: *A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face grins and steps forward, wiping his hands on his apron.*

npc: a lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
question: Have you seen Father Declan today?

response_lines.speaker: System
response_lines.text: Fr. Declan Tierney is not here.

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: Haven't seen him yet this mornin', no. I've been at the bellows here since first light, so he's likely up at St. Brigid's or out makin' his rounds by now. Are ye needin' him for somethin'?

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: *A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face wipes his hands on his leather apron.*

npc: a lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
question: And how is your own family keeping?

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: Ah, we're all well, thanks be to God—Da's hard at the anvil here, and Mam's away home seein' to the fire and the pot. And how's yourself keepin' this spring mornin'?

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: *A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face nods toward the anvil where his father is working.*

npc: a lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
question: Is old Festus the cooper still at his shop by the bridge?

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: Old Festus the cooper? I know no such man, friend—nor any coopery by a bridge in these parts. There's Kearney the wheelwright down the lane, but that's all I can tell ye.

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: *A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face shrugs and wipes soot from his brow.*

npc: a lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
question: How do I get to the abbey in town?

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: An abbey? There's no abbey in these parts, friend — nor any town with one. Ye'd best ask the right person hereabouts if ye're lookin' for a church; St. Brigid's is the only one I know.

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: *A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face wipes his forehead with a sooty sleeve.*

npc: a lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
question: Tell me about your work, but keep it brief.

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: Mhuise, 'tis a deal of work for one lad — bellows at the fire, iron in the tongs, and a hammer when Da lets me near it. I've got a horseshoe rough-shaped meself now, though Da'll not trust me with a good shire's hoof yet.

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: *A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face wipes a sooty sleeve across his brow and grins.*

npc: a lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
question: I cannot sleep for worrying. What would you advise?

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: Ah, sure I'd tell ye a good long walk along the Bog Road—till yer legs are that heavy ye can't keep yer eyes open. That's what cures me when Da's hammerin' keeps me awake. Ye might sleep right through cock-crow after that.

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: *A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face nods earnestly and jerks a thumb toward the lane.*

npc: a lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
question: Do you know Padraig Darcy?

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: Aye, that I do — Padraig runs Darcy's Pub over in Curraghboy Village, and a fine pint he pulls too. Are ye after him for somethin'?

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: *A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face wipes his sooty hands on his apron.*

npc: a lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
question: What can you tell me of Ballyglass Castle?

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: Ballyglass Castle? I know of no such place hereabouts, friend — there's no castle in this parish that I've ever heard tell of. Ye'd best ask the right person in the village, for I can't help ye with that.

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: *A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face scratches his head and looks puzzled.*

npc: a lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
question: I heard Cormac Duffy was at the mill. Is that true?

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: I can't say for sure, friend — I've been here at the forge since first light, and I've not seen Cormac this mornin'. He might well be at the mill, but I wouldn't swear to it. Why d'ye ask?

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: *A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face shrugs and glances toward the mill road.*

npc: a lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
question: Thank you. I should let you return to your work.

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: Ah, go on with ye — 'twas no trouble at all. Mind the muddy lane outside, now. Slán leat, mo chara.

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: *A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face wipes his hands on his leather apron and nods toward the anvil.*
